style_reference.flag_rule: Flat solid field, one centered Japanese mon, one ink color, no texture, no gradient, no text, no scene, no European shield.
style_reference.mission_rule: Painted late-Muromachi square scene, opaque like vanilla EU4 mission icons, readable at 59x63, no text.
style_reference.event_rule: Painted late-Muromachi or Sengoku historical scene, key action in a central ultra-wide band, no text or border.
